family: CMSA annual mainland-China Spartina vector maps 2017-2021
what_it_is: Five annual national Spartina alterniflora maps (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021) delivered as one zip archive from NESDC, containing five ESRI shapefile sets (dbf/prj/shp/shx), one per year.

Polygons in EPSG:32650 (WGS84 UTM 50N) with fields Id, gridcode, Area_ha, geometry; gridcode 2 = Spartina positive; gridcode 0 = small total-area features of UNKNOWN semantics (excluded from positive totals).
Produced with DeepLabv3+ semantic segmentation trained on 2020 Sentinel-2 imagery and transferred to the other years (time-series mapping / transfer learning / deep learning keywords).
Underlying model input is 10 m Sentinel-2 raster; delivered entities are vectorised polygons. The polygon boundaries are not themselves a '10 m geometric resolution' measurement.
what_it_is_not: Not a GOLD product: no field/UAV verification chain supplied; SILVER published external reference.
Not the 58,006 ha comparator: that figure is a single-year (2020) comparator quoted in the CM-SSM paper, not an area of this product and not a per-year series.
Not evidence of year-to-year change: annual differences mix methodology/transfer-learning and scale effects with real dynamics; no change inference may be drawn from map disagreement.
Not a GeoTIFF package despite XLS format metadata; delivered bytes are shapefiles.
